notes.title: Icycle: On Thin Ice is coming 25th October!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30840587/a1813d19e70f51a2d53a1046f4c709be19666bea.gif[/img]
Eight whole years have passed since the original Icycle appeared on the web. I can't quite come to terms with that.
Now Dennis is finally defrosting again for PC & Mac in this rediculous sequel which makes the original feel like a light lunch break time killer.

Just over two weeks to go folks, [b]hang in there![/b]
